unit.why: The division strings together several short anecdotes about the Maggid: his remark on a young man's prayer, a teaching on eating, his exchange with a wealthy man about how often he visits, and his protest at being kept from his study.
unit.boundary_note: The second item ('כשאתה קם משנתך...') is a saying without narrative and is not counted as a story.

stories.start_quote: עו״ש שפעם אחת אמר המגיד זצ״ל
stories.end_quote: תראה שלמחר ג״כ תתפלל כמו היום
stories.summary_en: The Maggid, who led the daily prayers and knew who prayed well, tells a young man that he prayed better than the Maggid himself that day and should pray the same way tomorrow.

quotes: שהתפלל בכל יום לפני העמוד בעצמו
tags.why: The anecdote turns on the quality of communal prayer.

quotes: והיה יודע מי התפלל עמו בטוב
tags.why: The Maggid knows the inner quality of others' prayer.
The tzaddik admits that a young man prayed better than he did.
The Maggid guides a young man who prays with him.

missing_concepts: the tzaddik as prayer leader (שליח ציבור)

stories.start_quote: עוד אמר לגביר אחד שהיה מופלג
stories.summary_en: A learned rich man visits the Maggid only once a year because each trip costs about ten roubles; the Maggid says he has no need of the man's money and tells him to divide the ten roubles into three visits.

quotes: שהיה בא אצל המגיד פעם אחת בשנה
קשה לי ליסע אצליכם בכל פעם
tags.why: The subject is how often the man travels to the tzaddik.

quotes: מפני מה מעלתו לא יבא אלי
tags.why: The Maggid addresses a visitor about his visits to the court.
The value lies in being near the tzaddik, not in the gifts brought.

missing_concepts: the cost of travel and gifts to the tzaddik

stories.start_quote: עוד פעם אחת היו אצלו הרבה
stories.summary_en: Many petitioners keep the Maggid from his regular study, and he warns them that he must keep up his study, for only then can he act on their behalf.

quotes: שלא היה לו שהות ללמוד כמנהגו
tags.why: The tzaddik's fixed Torah study is the issue.

quotes: היו אצלו הרבה אנשים עם הרבה עסקים
tags.why: Crowds of petitioners at the court.

quotes: ואז אוכל בעזרת השי״ת לפעול לכם
tags.why: The tzaddik's power to act for others depends on his own spiritual work.
The scene is the tzaddik's court crowded with visitors.
